"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (18, 22, 34)
PLAYER_COLOUR = (214, 142, 62)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PLAYER_COLOUR, player)
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

"""A tiny game to build on. Change the numbers and see what happens."""

import pygame

from scene import Colour, Scene, Sky, Tree

# Things you can change
WIDTH = 640
HEIGHT = 480
PLAYER_SPEED = 5
PLAYER_SIZE = 40
BACKGROUND = (40, 70, 150)

pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
pygame.display.set_caption("My Game")
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

player = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE)

# The scene: everything the game shows, drawn back to front by scene.draw().
scene = Scene(screen)
sky = scene.add("sky", Sky(BACKGROUND), size=(640, 480), at=(0, 0), layer="background")
tree = scene.add("tree", Tree(),
                 size=(100, 200),
                 at=[(100, 100), (200, 150), (300, 120), (400, 180), (500, 140)],
                 layer="scenery")
scene.add("player", Colour("green", round=6), rect=player, layer="things")
monster = scene.add("monster", Tree("red"),
                    size=(60, 60),
                    at=[(120, 120), (220, 170), (320, 140), (420, 190), (520, 160)],
                    layer="things")

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            running = False

    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
    if keys[pygame.K_LEFT]:
        player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_RIGHT]:
        player.x += PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    player.clamp_ip(screen.get_rect())

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching monster sends the player back to the start.
    if scene.touched(player, "monster"):
        player.topleft = (WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2)
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()

import pygame

], size=(100, 133), at=[(100, 100), (200, 150), (300, 120), (400, 180), (500, 140), (600, 110)], layer="scenery")

monster = scene.add("monster", Tree("red"),
                    size=(60, 60),
                    at=[(120, 120), (220, 170), (320, 140), (420, 190), (520, 160)],
                    layer="things")

running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():

    if keys[pygame.K_UP]:
        player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED
    if keys[pygame.K_DOWN]:
        player.y += PLAYER_SPEED

    scene.update()
    # Open Nest: touching monster sends the player back to the start.
    if scene.touched(player, "monster"):
        player.topleft = (WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2)
    screen.fill(BACKGROUND)
    scene.draw()
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)

pygame.quit()
